RED-FIRST CAPTURE — the typed mutate(update) auto-summary derives from PRE-merge metadata.

commit:  31df69afbb24c739e2aa6bcb59eae17fa420b148
date:    2026-08-11
command: cd cmd/knowledge && CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./internal/tools/ \
             -run '^TestTypedUpdate_PostMergeMetadataDrivesSummary$' -count=1 -v
         (piped through a two-expression sed making in-repo paths repo-relative
          and redacting any remaining absolute home path)

WHAT IS RED: all five subtests fail against the unfixed tree — each derived
summary embeds the value the update is REPLACING, because the deriver reads the
node's stored metadata instead of the merged map the same call is about to store.

================================================================================
RED-FIRST CAPTURE — TestTypedUpdate_DerivedSummaryLengthGuard, against the
PRE-GATE tree (the post-merge derive correction has already landed).

date:    2026-08-11
command: cd cmd/knowledge && CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./internal/tools/ \
             -run '^TestTypedUpdate_DerivedSummaryLengthGuard$' -count=1 -v
         (same two-expression sed redaction as the capture above)

WHAT IS RED: exactly ONE subtest — oversized_derived_summary_rejects_with_zero_forwards.
Without the gate the 573-rune derived summary is forwarded and the update
SUCCEEDS, so the assertion on the rejection is what fails. The other four are
characterization guards and pass both before and after the gate.
